Figure 1: TraceSQL feature-construction pipeline. Diagnostic evidence is transformed into five feature families through LLMbased probe assessment, direct projection of Pair Analyzer rule statuses, and deterministic SQL-AST extraction using SQLGlot. The resulting 10+5+32+10+10 = 67 features are aligned at the candidate level andmerged into the unifiedmodel representation, while richer diagnostic evidence is retained separately for traceability.
